records.author: Copilot
records.body:
Scaffold canonical repository structure for GPT-BRG12 (OKHP³ BrandGuard™ — Mathews Archery) with organized folders for product specs, prompts, knowledge base, GTM materials, and operational artifacts.

## Directory Structure

Created 15 directories organized by function:
- **Content & Knowledge**: `product/`, `prompts/`, `knowledge/`, `rag-source/`
- **Quality & Operations**: `tests/`, `eval/`, `build/`, `ops/`
- **Go-to-Market**: `gtm/{web,social,kofi,youtube}/`
- **Project Management**: `docs/`, `releases/`, `assets/`

## Core Files

- **gpt_manifest.yaml**: Project metadata with links to ChatGPT Project, Custom GPT, Notion workspace, AskJamie page, and Mathews Archery brand lens
- **CHANGELOG.md**: Version history following Keep a Changelog format
- **LICENSE**: MIT License
- **.gitignore**: Standard exclusions for OS files, IDEs, dependencies, build artifacts

All directories contain `.gitkeep` files for git tracking.

> Create repo OKHP3/AskJamie-GPT-BRG12 as the canonical container for GPT‑BRG12: OKHP³ BrandGuard™ — Mathews Archery. Add README.md, CHANGELOG.md, LICENSE, .gitignore, and gpt_manifest.yaml with links from the Mathews Archery lens, AskJamie page, ChatGPT Project, Notion BRG12, and Custom GPT.

Preserves the BRG12 Project's useful historical work as a static corpus and design packet: 17 unchanged DOCX/PDF pairs with text companions, private editions of all 34 observed expansions, 17 private Project-shared original downloads, portable prompts/worksheets, source extracts and evidence ledgers. The closeout audit reconciles the later S25 intake, corrects stale archive-status wording and keeps every remaining source hold. Raw captures, original methodology documents, account crosswalks and recovery receipts stay outside Git.

Validation: all 34 original corpus hashes and 13 prior payload hashes remain unchanged; the 17-companion checker passes. A fresh full expansion check preserves all 2,413 substantive parents with exact text, root partitions and links. Both private packet manifests and ZIP hashes/CRC pass. A separate XML-to-Markdown sequence check retains all 6,139 nonempty original paragraphs. JSON/Python parsing, local links, privacy/style and whitespace checks pass. The technology checker passes. No required branch review/check policy or ruleset was found; the inspected head has no check runs or commit statuses, so no successful PR CI run is claimed.

The whole-Project greater-than-60-percent minimum and greater-than-80-percent goal remain NOT DEMONSTRATED. Nineteen generated-file references, original Chat attachment identities and unobserved history remain unresolved. The scoped expansion ratio and file/byte counts are not whole-Project semantic weights. The dated closeout handoff records BLOCKED and the exact source input needed to resume. This PR integrates preserved artifacts; it does not complete the source-recovery objective or authorize thread archival.

Historical claims remain unverified as current. No tested runtime, formal release approval, rights clearance, deployment, Replit synchronization or new source archive is claimed. No linked Replit project was identified in this harvest's available scope.
